name: Yumemigaoka
source:
This town Yumamigaoka is named after a hill that has a legend about dreams coming true.
Town gets largely depopulated, and remaining children have to study elsewhere. But suddenly they get temporally transferred to Yumamigaoka abandoned school. This summer brings nostalgia and hopes for the dreams to come true.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/11/vn-of-month-september-2005-gunjou-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
